patterns: Do you deliver to my city
responses: Shipping fees depend on your city  -  enter your delivery address at checkout and the fee will be calculated automatically.
We deliver across all listed cities in Myanmar. The exact fee is shown once you select your city on the checkout page.
Delivery usually takes 2-5 business days depending on your location.
You can check your order status by logging in and visiting the 'My Orders' page.
Order tracking is available under your account's Orders section  -  it shows Processing, Shipped, or Delivered.
For a specific order, please share your order number and I can help point you in the right direction.

patterns: How do I cancel an order
I want to cancel my purchase
responses: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped from your 'My Orders' page. Once shipped, please contact support instead.
Go to My Orders, select the order, and choose Cancel if it's still in Processing status.
Most electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unopened and in original packaging.
Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
To start a return, go to My Orders, select the item, and choose 'Request Return'.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept
Can I pay with cash on delivery
responses: We accept credit/debit cards, mobile wallets, and cash on delivery depending on your city.
At checkout you'll see all available payment options for your delivery address.

patterns: How do I use a promo code
responses: You can enter a coupon code at checkout in the 'Apply Coupon' field.
Check our homepage or Deals section for currently active discount codes.
Coupons apply automatically once entered and validated at checkout.

patterns: Do you have this item available
responses: You can check real-time stock on the product page  -  it shows 'In Stock' or 'Out of Stock' clearly.
If an item shows out of stock, you can enable notifications and we'll let you know when it's restocked.

patterns: What's a good smartphone under budget
responses: Sure! Let me know your budget and what you'll mainly use it for, and I can point you to the right category.
Check out our Featured Products section for top picks in each category  -  Smartphones, Laptops, Audio, Cameras, and more.
Browse by category on our Products page  -  you can filter by brand and price to find the best match.
Prices are listed on each product page along with current stock and specs.
You can find the exact price on the product detail page  -  let me know the product name if you'd like me to check.

patterns: Is this product covered under warranty
responses: Most electronics come with a manufacturer warranty of 6-12 months  -  check the product description for specifics.
Warranty terms vary by brand and are listed on the product page under 'Details'.

patterns: How do I create an account
How do I reset my password
How do I update my profile
responses: You can create an account or sign in from the top navigation menu.
To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the sign-in page and follow the instructions sent to your email.

patterns: How do I save an item for later
Where is my saved items list
responses: Click the heart icon on any product to add it to your Wishlist  -  you can find saved items under 'My Wishlist'.

patterns: I need to talk to a human
responses: You can reach our support team through the Contact page, or email us  -  we usually respond within 24 hours.
I can help with common questions, but for anything account-specific, please use the Contact Support page for a human agent.

patterns: What kind of products do you have
responses: LectroHub carries Smartphones, Laptops, Audio, Cameras, Drones, Gaming, Tablets, Wearables, TVs, and Accessories.

patterns: What items are in my last order
responses: Let me pull that up for you.
